title: Jenkins CI
intro: Jenkins interview questions cover the CI server still running half the world's Java backend pipelines — declarative vs scripted pipelines, Jenkinsfile structure, agents, shared libraries, credentials and secrets, plugin ecosystem, multi-branch pipelines, and the upgrade-and-stability concerns that come up in interviews for Jenkins-heavy shops. For broader CI/CD comparisons (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), see the CI/CD page.
